name: [UNOFFICIAL] TaCZ Refabricated (26.3 R1-hotfix)
description: An unofficial Fabric port of Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero, based on upstream 1.1.8-hotfix. R1-hotfix for Minecraft 26.3 is the first hotfix build on the R1 baseline of the 26.3 line, ported from the 26.2 R3-hotfix2 source: it migrates the renderer to Mojang's RenderPearl backend (com.mojang.blaze3d.* -> com.mojang.renderpearl.*), follows vanilla's split of ItemInHandRenderer into FirstPersonHandsAndItems plus FirstPersonHandsAndItemsRenderer, updates the scope shaders to ShaderC #include, and restores REI 26.3.823, Zoomify 2.16.3+26.3, and Shoulder Surfing Reloaded 26.3-5.2.0+fabric compatibility alongside JEI and Carry On 2.12.0. R1 also reworks the Iris 26.3 scope-mask mode detection, adds pipeline prewarming, migrates block loot tables to the 26.3 schema, parses gun-smith recipe ingredients lazily so legacy gun packs no longer break world loading, and opts vanilla recipe serializers into Fabric recipe sync so client JEI/REI works on dedicated servers without JEI/REI. The R1 baseline was verified in-game by the maintainer (vanilla, Iris, dedicated server) in September 2026; the R1-hotfix updates have passed CI/static checks and await in-game verification. See docs/CHANGELOG_26_3_R1.md for coverage details. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the TACZ Dev Team. The version keeps 1.1.8 as its SemVer core and uses '+fabric.26.3.R1-hotfix' build metadata so existing gun-pack version requirements continue to work.
contributors: TACZ Dev Team (upstream Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero)
